items.q: Keeter. Right. Right. Right. There it was. There's the quintet, right there.

ctx.x: Keeter. Right. Right. Right. There it was. There's the quintet, right there. So I don’t know which came first, going abroad with Basie or going abroad with this quintet with Oscar Pettiford and entertaining the servicemen in the Far East.
I’m almost certain it was the Basie band first . . .
